page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred lines of text, an engraved device (printer's emblem) in the middle, imprint below the device. No margin notes. Printed page number "2" in the top right corner is a handwritten number and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Engraved printer's device in the centre: a hand holding compasses over a plane figure, within a wreath of fruit and a band with lettering (partly illegible). The imprint date reads cIↄ. Iↄ. Ic., i.e. MDCIC in the old form, printed as shown; the last numeral is not fully clear. Handwritten "2" at top right is not transcribed.
